inputs: Reuse byte-identical diagnostic closed SQLite seeds and synthetic JSONL inputs; hash every member. Never regenerate or trim a measured seed.
sampling: 12 matched pairs per cell; alternate baseline/candidate first; each invocation uses a new byte-verified copy of the same closed seed. One excluded labeled warmup per arm/cell. No reruns, trimming or outlier removal.
environment: Same managed worker job, Go1.27.1, CGO_ENABLED=0, GOAMD64=v1, GOMAXPROCS=6; shared desktop host. Both binaries built in same job.

metrics.wall: Uninstrumented supported CLI query elapsed including opening, query, trace, emission and close
metrics.rss: Per-process /usr/bin/time maximum RSS KiB, not allocation bytes
metrics.stage: Separate stage-instrumented invocation per arm/cell for open and queryItems and verification attribution; no adoption timing
metrics.allocations: Separate main-entry-to-main-exit runtime.TotalAlloc delta per arm/cell without stage hooks; not startup RSS
metrics.wal: Focused bounded read-snapshot/writer-progress test with checkpoint frames, WAL bytes before/during/after read release, separate from latency samples

gates.correctness: All stable evidence, packet IDs, ranks, text, ranges, digests, accounting and policy fields identical baseline/candidate; fresh request identities; full required tests and race tests pass
gates.large_latency: At history200 shared and diverse, each packing policy median wall improves at least15%
gates.small_latency: At history0 all three fixtures and both policies, candidate median wall no more than10% slower
gates.history_small_latency: Small fixture at history200 both policies no more than10% slower
gates.tail: Each cell candidate maximum wall no more than25% above baseline maximum
gates.rss: Each cell median RSS no greater than baseline median plus max(15%,2048KiB)
gates.allocation: Each cell candidate main allocated bytes no more than10% above baseline

failure: Any gate failure rejects adoption; retain all observations and source. Abort on invalid fixture, CLI error, timeout or unequal output; do not choose favorable replacements.
scope: Synthetic repeated-query history, not natural documents, sustained multiwriter throughput, histories beyond200, large ancestry graphs or universal performance. Previously published study remains unchanged. Original policy stays default.
